summary: Defines GMPLS signaling extensions for Shared Mesh Protection (SMP), where several working paths can share backup resources. It builds on ITU-T recommendations G.808.3 and G.873.3 and on the requirements in RFC 7412. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: Several roads share one spare bridge. If one road fails, traffic uses the spare. This document teaches the network how to reserve and switch to that shared bridge.

questions: what is gmpls shared mesh protection
how does gmpls signal shared protection resources
